meta.name: JOURNY TV
meta.description:
JOURNY is a global travel TV destination showcasing award-winning series and original content. With authenticity, diversity, and global perspectives, JOURNY inspires Conscious Explorers to turn screen moments into real-world adventures.

Shows: Porthole Cruise and Travel Show, Health Explored, Epic Trails, Travel Man, Paradise Kitchen Bali
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
